messages:
Marta R: Quick sync — we need the whats-new + changelog blurb for today's docs publish. I added a raw changelog in PR 982 but need copy and snippet updates.
Eli T: on it. which PR is the source?
Marta R: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/982 — highlights: adaptive-routing note, streaming-embeddings deprecation, JS SDK snippet cleanup.
Samir P: I9ll update JS. question: call out fallback policy change under Notable changes or keep in migration guide?
Marta R: Put it under Notable changes (two lines). Link migration guide for details.
Eli T: Draft whats-new bullets: - Adaptive routing improvements to reduce tail latency and cost during bursts. - Streaming embeddings deprecated; see migration steps. - SDK snippets refreshed (JS/Python/Go) for retries and function-call examples.
Jules: Known issue one-liner: "Prefix cache TTL can cause minor quality regressions for very long-running sessions when KV cache spans model rollouts."
Samir P: Pushed JS snippet (PR 985): streaming->polling migration example added.
Marta R: Add compatibility note: "Batch mode preserves ordering but increases latency for single-request use."
Jen P: Mirrored Python snippet in PR 990; confirmed client.poll API names. Added Dedicated tip: "If on Dedicated, configure conservative fallback thresholds during rollouts."
Jules: Changelog entry added to docs/changelog/1.4.0.md with links to PRs. Fixed a broken anchor in migration guide (commit c7f2).
Marta R: Remaining: final proof of whats-new (Eli/Marta), confirm snippets across langs (Samir/Jen/Go lead), add known-issues to changelog (Jules), tag internal digest for CS/SRE (Marta). Will merge after CI and schedule docs publish for 17:30 PT. :rocket:
